units.source_text: “你竟然连那些小事都记得这么清楚啊。”

en.t: You even remember little things like that so clearly.

units.source_text: 丈夫笑着调侃，信子默默听着，只回以一个媚色。

en.t: Her husband laughed and teased her, while Nobuko listened silently and answered only with a coquettish look.

units.source_text: 但是，至于自己为什么可以记得如此清楚，她也说不清楚。

en.t: But as for why she could remember it so clearly, she herself could not explain.
